description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” compares the performance of two models — LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars) — across nine different datasets and evaluation metrics, with scores reported as percentages on the vertical axis ranging from 0 to 80. The horizontal axis lists the benchmarks: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. In most benchmarks, the “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model achieves higher or comparable scores to LLaMA-3-8B-it; for instance, on GSM-8K, both models score near 80%, while on TruthfulQA, “Ours” scores approximately 60% versus ~45% for LLaMA-3-8B-it. Notable exceptions include LC AlpacaEval2 and Chat-Arena-Hard, where “Ours” significantly outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it (around 35% vs. 25% and 30% vs. 20%, respectively). The chart visually emphasizes the consistent edge of the Iterative RLHF approach across diverse academic and practical benchmarks, particularly in more challenging or specialized tasks. The legend in the top-right corner clearly distinguishes the two models by color, and the bars are grouped by benchmark for direct comparison.
